messages.text:
Hi Tanya,

Sorry for the long delay getting back to you on this, it's not how we usually operate.

On the fee: since the collar didn't perform the way it should have for you, we'll waive the $9.99 handling fee and process a full refund once the collar is back with us.

On the label: yes, Canada Post can scan the QR code straight from your phone, no printer needed. Just go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ with your order number (L-42385) and postal code, and you'll get a QR code to show at the counter.

Once the return is in transit, we'll issue the full refund.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
